name: Ane Rape ~Kouman na Ane no Nureta Bishin~
original_name: 姉レイプ～高慢な姉の濡れた美唇～
source:
Takashi has an older sister, Natsuki, who is beautiful and kind to everyone. But she is very harsh to him at home. One day, he accidentally sees Natsuki changing clothes, and gets sexually excited. He can't stand it anymore, and pushes her down on the bed...

translation:
Takashi有一个姐姐Natsuki，她美丽且对每个人都很友善。但她在家里对他却很严厉。有一天，他无意中看到夏希换衣服，顿时性兴奋起来。他再也忍不住了，将她按倒在床上……
